---
title: "TRUST4 sequences by chain and tissue (Fig. 1E, Supplemental Table 1)"
---

Moved from `dataset/build_dataset.Rmd` ("TRUST4 compact isotype summary") so the figure stage can
make it without rebuilding the dataset. Unfiltered (no productive / complete-VDJ filter): the raw
extraction yield per chain type / isotype, SRA studies only.

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
source(here::here("R", "trust4_files.R"))
source(here::here("R", "metadata.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(vroom)
```

```{r Fig 1E: sequences by chain and tissue}
sra_meta_sum <- read_metadata() %>%
  select(Run, BioProject, create_date, Tissue, Age, Sex, DonorID, Disease)

# Step 1: classify chain type and aggregate per (SRA, chain_type) — no join yet
trust4_sra <-
  vroom(data_path("sequences/master-trust4-dataset-sequence-unfiltered.csv"),
        col_select = c(file_name, v_call, c_call), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(file_name %in% keep_one_file_per_run(unique(file_name))) %>%   # one file per run (R/trust4_files.R)
  mutate(
    SRA = str_extract(file_name, "(SRR|ERR)[0-9]+"),
    chain_type = case_when(
      str_starts(v_call, "IGHV") ~ coalesce(c_call, "IGH_unknown"),
      str_starts(v_call, "IGKV") ~ "IGK",
      str_starts(v_call, "IGLV") ~ "IGL",
      str_starts(v_call, "TR")   ~ "TCR",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SRA), !is.na(chain_type)) %>%
  group_by(SRA, chain_type) %>%
  summarise(n_seqs = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: join the small (SRA × chain_type) table to metadata — fast
trust4_pre_meta <- trust4_sra %>%
  left_join(sra_meta_sum, by = c("SRA" = "Run")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Disease), !is.na(BioProject)) %>%
  mutate(tissue_group = case_when(
    Tissue %in% c('Brain', 'Brain-Lesion', 'Cortex', 'Choroid-Plexus', 'Pia-Mater') ~ 'Brain',
    Tissue %in% c('Cerebrospinal-Fluid', 'CSF')  ~ 'CSF',
    Tissue %in% c('Blood', 'PBMC')                ~ 'Blood',
    TRUE ~ 'Other'
  ))

total_seqs <- sum(trust4_pre_meta$n_seqs)

trust4_pre_meta %>%
  group_by(Chain_Type = chain_type) %>%
  summarise(
    N_seqs    = sum(n_seqs),
    Pct       = round(100 * sum(n_seqs) / total_seqs, 1),
    Pct_Blood = round(100 * sum(n_seqs[tissue_group == 'Blood']) / sum(n_seqs), 1),
    Pct_CSF   = round(100 * sum(n_seqs[tissue_group == 'CSF'])   / sum(n_seqs), 1),
    Pct_Brain = round(100 * sum(n_seqs[tissue_group == 'Brain']) / sum(n_seqs), 1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(N_seqs)) -> fig1e_table

FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_csv(fig1e_table, file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig1E_sequences_by_chain_and_tissue.csv"))

fig1e_table %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "TRUST4 sequences by chain/isotype (unfiltered; SRA studies only)",
    col.names = c("Chain / Isotype", "N seqs", "% total", "% Blood", "% CSF", "% Brain")
  )
```

```{r Supplemental Table 1: per-study statistics}
# One row per BioProject — full per-study breakdown for a supplemental figure/table.
# All Pct_ values are fractions of total sequences across all chain types.

# Per-subject total sequences (all chain types)
subj_counts_bp <- trust4_pre_meta %>%
  group_by(BioProject, DonorID) %>%
  summarise(subj_seqs = sum(n_seqs), .groups = 'drop')

# Donor-level demographics — deduplicated to avoid inflating median / counts
donor_stats <- trust4_pre_meta %>%
  distinct(BioProject, DonorID, Age, Sex) %>%
  group_by(BioProject) %>%
  summarise(
    N_female   = sum(Sex == 'Female', na.rm = TRUE),
    N_male     = sum(Sex == 'Male',   na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_age = round(median(as.numeric(Age), na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

trust4_pre_meta %>%
  group_by(BioProject) %>%
  summarise(
    Disease_categories = paste(sort(unique(Disease)), collapse = ' / '),
    N_subjects         = n_distinct(DonorID),
    N_seqs             = sum(n_seqs),
    Tissues            = paste(sort(unique(tissue_group[tissue_group != 'Other'])), collapse = ', '),
    Pct_IgM = round(100 * sum(n_seqs[chain_type == 'IGHM'])                / sum(n_seqs), 1),
    Pct_IgG = round(100 * sum(n_seqs[str_starts(chain_type, 'IGHG')])      / sum(n_seqs), 1),
    Pct_IgA = round(100 * sum(n_seqs[str_starts(chain_type, 'IGHA')])      / sum(n_seqs), 1),
    Pct_IGK = round(100 * sum(n_seqs[chain_type == 'IGK'])                 / sum(n_seqs), 1),
    Pct_IGL = round(100 * sum(n_seqs[chain_type == 'IGL'])                 / sum(n_seqs), 1),
    Pct_TCR = round(100 * sum(n_seqs[chain_type == 'TCR'])                 / sum(n_seqs), 1),
    Year    = year(min(create_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    subj_counts_bp %>%
      group_by(BioProject) %>%
      summarise(Median_seqs_subject = round(median(subj_seqs)), .groups = 'drop'),
    by = 'BioProject'
  ) %>%
  left_join(donor_stats, by = 'BioProject') %>%
  select(BioProject, Disease_categories, N_subjects, N_seqs, Median_seqs_subject,
         Tissues, Pct_IgM, Pct_IgG, Pct_IgA, Pct_IGK, Pct_IGL, Pct_TCR,
         N_female, N_male, Median_age, Year) %>%
  arrange(desc(N_subjects)) -> table_s1

write_csv(table_s1, file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "tableS1_sra_studies.csv"))

table_s1 %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "TRUST4 SRA studies: pre-sampling statistics (all chain types, unfiltered)",
    col.names = c("BioProject", "Diseases", "N subjects", "N seqs", "Median seqs/subj",
                  "Tissues", "% IgM", "% IgG", "% IgA", "% IGK", "% IGL", "% TCR",
                  "N female", "N male", "Median age", "Year")
  )
```
